## Signal definition
What does this signal detect, in one sentence?

## Threshold
When does it fire? Give concrete numbers or conditions.

## Owner rule
Who is named as the owner when it fires, and how is that person found?

## Next action
What should the reader do when they see it?

## Fixture
Attach or describe a minimal fixture (Linear/GitHub/Slack data) that should trigger it, and one that should not.
